# Nexus Media

> Nexus Media (NEXUS MEDIA) is an agency in Manila, Philippines that businesses abroad (US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe) outsource to for video editing, social media management, web development and business/system automation. Clients get agency-quality work at Philippine rates, much lower than local agencies in those countries. All services are delivered online. Website: https://nexusmediaph.com

Nexus Media is one connected team for web, automation, social media and video. Clients get a free quote within 24 hours through the contact form at https://nexusmediaph.com/#contact.

## Services

- [Outsourcing agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/outsourcing-agency-philippines/): one Manila team for video editing, social media, web development and automation, for clients worldwide at Philippine rates.
- [Web development agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/web-development-agency-philippines/): custom websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores and web apps; responsive, SEO-ready, typical launch in 2–4 weeks.
- [System automation agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/system-automation-agency-philippines/): business process and workflow automation, custom business systems, inventory and sales tracking, lead capture and automated follow-up emails, content posting automation.
- [Video editing agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/video-editing-agency-philippines/): reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and long-form, video ads, motion graphics, captions, colour grading; reels delivered in about 48 hours.
- [Social media management agency in the Philippines](https://nexusmediaph.com/social-media-management-agency-philippines/): content strategy and calendar, post and reel design, Meta and TikTok ads, community management, monthly reports.

## Specialised services

- [Real estate video editing](https://nexusmediaph.com/real-estate-video-editing-services/): Outsource real estate video editing to the Philippines. Listing tours, agent reels and drone edits for US, Canadian and UK agents and brokerages, under $25/hr, fast turnaround.
- [YouTube video editing](https://nexusmediaph.com/youtube-video-editing-services/): Hire a YouTube video editor team in the Philippines. Long-form edits, Shorts, podcast clips and thumbnails-ready cuts for creators and brands in the US, Canada and UK, under $25/hr.
- [Social media management for real estate agents](https://nexusmediaph.com/social-media-management-for-real-estate-agents/): Affordable social media management for real estate agents in the US, Canada and UK. Listing posts, agent reels, Meta lead ads and daily replies from our Philippine team, from about $1,000/mo.
- [Social media management for small business](https://nexusmediaph.com/social-media-management-for-small-business/): Affordable social media management for small businesses in the US, Canada and UK. Content, reels, Meta and TikTok ads and replies from our Philippine team, from about $1,000/month.
- [Small business website design](https://nexusmediaph.com/small-business-website-design/): Affordable website design for small businesses in the US, Canada and UK. Fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready sites from our Philippine team, from about $1,000, live in 2–4 weeks.
- [Website design for contractors](https://nexusmediaph.com/website-design-for-contractors/): Websites for contractors, plumbers, roofers, electricians and home service businesses in the US, Canada and UK. Built to get calls and quote requests, from about $1,000.

## Cost guides

- [How much does it cost to outsource video editing to the Philippines?](https://nexusmediaph.com/blog/cost-to-outsource-video-editing-philippines/): Philippine agency rates are under 25 USD per hour vs about 40–100+ USD in the US, UK and Australia; typical editing time per reel, YouTube video and ad.
- [How much does it cost to outsource web development to the Philippines?](https://nexusmediaph.com/blog/cost-to-outsource-web-development-philippines/): under 25 USD per hour vs about 75–150+ USD at US, UK and Australian agencies; typical build hours for landing pages, business sites, stores and web apps.
- [How much does social media management cost in the Philippines?](https://nexusmediaph.com/blog/cost-to-outsource-social-media-management-philippines/): monthly packages from about 1,000 USD at Nexus Media vs often 2,000–10,000+ USD at US, UK and Australian agencies; ad spend paid separately.
